channelNorms.reason: Decided on visual proof and social validation, in a short window. Creative quality dominates channel choice, and unit economics are decided by shipping and returns rather than by messaging.

priceBands.note: Uncited. Derive the ladder from live competitor pricing in this run and cite it.

cacBenchmarks.note: Uncited. Cite a published benchmark or leave unknown. Never use a prior.

regulatedClaims.claim: a health, weight, skin or wellness benefit
regulatedClaims.authority: FTC / EU consumer law / VN advertising law: health claims on non-medical goods need substantiation

regulatedClaims.claim: sustainable, eco-friendly, recyclable or carbon neutral
regulatedClaims.authority: EU Green Claims and FTC Green Guides: the basis must be stated

regulatedClaims.claim: was-now pricing, limited stock or a sale
regulatedClaims.authority: pricing-practice rules: a reference price must genuinely have been charged

regulatedClaims.claim: handmade, organic, or country of origin
regulatedClaims.authority: labelling law; several of these are certified terms

forbidden: a before-and-after image with no disclosure
an incentivised review presented as organic
a review score with no review count
a product image that misrepresents size, colour or contents

reservedTerms.meaning: made by hand, not assembled from kits.

requiredDisclosures: paid partnership on every creator post
the basis of any sustainability claim
seasonality: Q4 peak: Black Friday through December
